_comment1: HF Trainer --fsdp_config for Qwen2.5-VL full-parameter GRPO. Selected via `--fsdp "full_shard auto_wrap"` + `--fsdp_config <this>`.
_comment2: CRITICAL: transformers 4.49 only exports a subset of these keys to accelerate as FSDP_* env vars, and does NOT export fsdp version or state_dict_type. The launcher (_launch in run_real_input_self_evolve_loop.py) MUST export FSDP_VERSION=2 (else silently runs FSDP1) and FSDP_STATE_DICT_TYPE=FULL_STATE_DICT (else FSDP2 defaults to SHARDED_STATE_DICT and checkpoints can't be loaded by from_pretrained for carry-forward/eval).
